text: Install a skill collection with a single npx command using GitHub owner/repo shorthand
quote:
# GitHub shorthand (owner/repo)
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills

text: Install skills from git repos, arbitrary URLs, or local paths
quote: `skills add <pkg>` | Install skills from git repos, URLs, or local paths

text: Install from a full GitHub repository URL
quote:
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills

# Full GitHub URL
npx skills add https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills

text: Install from GitLab and Azure Repos (Azure DevOps Services or Server) URLs
quote:
# GitLab URL
npx skills add https://gitlab.com/org/repo

# Azure Repos (Azure DevOps Services or Server)
npx skills add https://dev.azure.com/org/project/_git/repo

text: Install from a direct SKILL.md or archive download URL
quote:
# Install from a direct SKILL.md or archive download URL
npx skills add https://example.com/download/my-skill

text: Install a single skill via a direct path to it inside a repository
quote:
# Direct path to a skill in a repo
npx skills add https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills/tree/main/skills/web-design-guidelines

text: Install only specific named skills from a collection, or all of them with '*'
quote: Install specific skills by name (use `'*'` for all skills)

text: Target installation at specific agents such as claude-code, codex, or opencode
quote: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills -a claude-code -a opencode

text: Supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 75 more coding agents
quote: Supports **OpenCode**, **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Cursor**, and [75 more](#supported-agents).

text: List the skills available in a repository without installing them
quote:
# List skills in a repository
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --list

text: Choose between project-local install (default) and global user-directory install with -g
quote: **Project** | (default) | `./<agent>/skills/` | Committed with your project, shared with team | **Global** | `-g` | `~/<agent>/skills/` | Available across all projects

text: Project-scoped skills are committed with the project and shared with the team
quote: **Project** | (default) | `./<agent>/skills/` | Committed with your project, shared with team

text: Non-interactive, CI/CD-friendly installation with flags and -y
quote:
# Non-interactive installation (CI/CD friendly)
npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill frontend-design -g -a claude-code -y

text: Same command works for public and private repositories using the existing configured auth
quote: Use the same command for public and private repositories. The CLI uses the authentication already configured for the repository URL

text: skills use writes a skill to a temp directory and prints a generated prompt to stdout for piping into an agent
quote: `skills use` resolves sources the same way as `skills add`, writes the selected skill files to a temporary directory, and prints only the generated prompt to stdout unless `--agent` is provided.

text: skills use with --agent starts a supported coding agent interactively with the generated prompt
quote: With `--agent`, it starts one supported agent interactively with the generated prompt.

text: Install creates symlinks from each agent to a single canonical copy of the skill
quote: **Symlink** (Recommended) | Creates symlinks from each agent to a canonical copy. Single source of truth, easy updates.

text: List all installed skills, similar to npm ls (alias ls)
quote: skills list                 | List installed skills (alias: `ls`)

text: Remove installed skills from specific agents
quote: npx skills remove --agent claude-code cursor my-skill

text: Search for skills interactively or by keyword
quote: Search for skills interactively or by keyword.

text: Search across every repository owned by an organization or user
quote: npx skills find react --owner vercel

text: Skills Leaderboard for discovering skills
quote: Skills Leaderboard

text: Update all installed skills, or specific ones by name, to latest versions
quote:
npx skills update

# Update a single skill by name
npx skills update my-skill

text: Restore skills from a skills-lock.json lockfile
quote: `skills i`, `skills install` (no args) restore from `skills-lock.json`.

text: Sync skills from node_modules into agent directories
quote: `skills experimental_sync` | Sync skills from node_modules into agent dirs

text: Create a new SKILL.md template with skills init
quote: npx skills init my-skill

text: SKILL.md files consist of YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content
quote: The SKILL.md file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.

text: Build a skill once and reuse it across any skills-compatible agent
quote: Cross-product reuse: Build a skill once and use it across any skills-compatible agent.

text: Validate a skill folder with skills-ref validate
quote: skills-ref validate ./my-skill

text: Agents load only each skill's name and description at startup to decide when it is relevant
quote: Discovery: At startup, agents load only the name and description of each available skill, just enough to know when it might be relevant.

text: Skills can bundle scripts, reference materials, templates, and other resources
quote: Skills can also bundle scripts, reference materials, templates, and other resources.

text: Optional allowed-tools frontmatter field lists pre-approved tools a skill may use (experimental)
quote: `allowed-tools` | No | Space-separated string of pre-approved tools the skill may use. (Experimental)

text: Optional license frontmatter field names a license or references a bundled license file
quote: `license` | No | License name or reference to a bundled license file.
